name: Xinjiang Beixin Road & Bridge Group Co., Ltd
summary: Xinjiang Beixin Road & Bridge Group Co., Ltd. engages in the construction business in China and internationally. It provides general construction contracting services and professional engineering contracting services; as well as investment, financing, and other construction services. The company also involved in the construction, investment, and design of highways, bridges, tunnels, and other infrastructure projects; financial leasing, and construction machinery and equipment leasing and sales; coal mining and washing; labor management; and real estate development and management. Xinjiang Beixin Road & Bridge Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Urumqi, China.
